messages.author: e955dbaa643fb64a
messages.subject: 'cannot make a template from a plot containing a template'...
parts:
Hi, 
     I've just come to Deducer, having sampled several other GUIs for R.  So far, it seems super!
     I thought I'd try my hand and creating a template from a scatterplot that is close to what I want.  In Plot Buider, when I select Tools> Make Template, I get the message I've put in the Subject line.  Yet, it seemed to me in the YouTube video creating a Rose Plot, the template was the starting point.  Where am I going wrong?

Thanks for your help,

Peter Mayer

messages.author: 056a0f54645c6009
messages.subject: Issue with recent installation of Deducer wit R3.1.1
parts:
Hi all,

Tried updating packages with the two lines below:

update.packages(ask = FALSE, dependencies = c('Suggests'))

update.packages(ask=FALSE, checkBuilt = TRUE)

And this seemed to fix the Java issue.
